requirements.summary: nginx was directly observed active, listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8443, and returning the expected body over certificate-validated HTTPS. The listener and successful response remained present after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before it expires.
requirements.summary: A persistent daily systemd timer was enabled and active with a scheduled next run. Its service successfully invoked the renewal program, which retained the certificate while it was valid beyond the seven-day renewal window. The same program was also directly shown generating a replacement certificate when forced.

requirements.requirement: Have the HTTPS service pick up each new certificate while continuing to answer requests.
requirements.summary: A bounded live rotation changed the certificate serial, nginx retained the same master PID through its graceful reload, all 100 requests made during the rotation succeeded, and the certificate subsequently served on port 8443 matched the replacement certificate.

overall_summary: All three material outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: it captured a healthy pre-restart state and boot identity, restart acknowledgement, a changed post-restart boot identity corroborated by the lifecycle snapshots, and recovered HTTPS service, certificate state, listener, and renewal timer.
limitations: The evidence did not wait for a naturally expiring certificate and observe the timer itself initiate a renewal. Automatic renewal is established by the active persistent timer, a successful timer-service invocation, and a separate forced execution of the same renewal program, so this is a minor evidence limitation rather than a functional failure.
HTTPS requests were tested from node1 against its managed-node address; no probe from a separate external client was captured.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Installing nginx, creating the certificate and rotation program, configuring the HTTPS site, and adding the systemd timer were directly necessary implementation steps. The forced rotation established bounded final behavioral evidence, and the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. Temporary probe files were removed, the final snapshot showed no failed services or package inconsistency, and only the intended port 8443 listeners were added. The failed connection during reboot is consistent with the requested restart and does not evidence an additional mutation.
